description.en: Authentic supplications of all prophets from the Quran

source.en: Quran — duas of Adam, Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, Yunus, Zakariya, Ayyub, Sulayman

title.en: Dua for Forgiveness (Adam & Hawwa)

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbana zalamna anfusana wa in lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal-khasirin.

translation.en: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.
translation.ar: ربنا ظلمنا أنفسنا وإن لم تغفر لنا وترحمنا لنكونن من الخاسرين

virtues.en: First dua of mankind after descent from Paradise.

title.en: Dua for Help

items.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي مَغْلُوبٌ فَانتَصِرْ
items.transliteration: Rabbi inni maghlubun fantasir.

translation.en: My Lord, I am overcome, so help [me].
translation.ar: رب إني مغلوب فانتصر

virtues.en: Dua of Nuh (AS) when overwhelmed by his people.

title.en: Dua for Boarding the Ark

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ مَجْرَاهَا وَمُرْسَاهَا ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi majraha wa mursaha, inna Rabbi laghafurur-rahim.

translation.en: In the name of Allah is its course and its anchorage. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful.
translation.ar: بسم الله مجراها ومرساها إن ربي لغفور رحيم

virtues.en: Said by Nuh (AS) when boarding the Ark.

title.en: Dua of Gratitude After the Flood

items.arabic: رَبِّ أَنزِلْنِي مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنزِلِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbi anzilni munzalan mubarakan wa anta khayrul-munzilin.

translation.en: My Lord, enable me to land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].
translation.ar: رب أنزلني منزلاً مباركاً وأنت خير المنزلين

virtues.en: Dua of Nuh (AS) upon safely landing after the flood.
virtues.ar: دعاء نوح بعد النجاة من الطوفان.

title.en: Du’a of Nuh — Victory Over Deniers

items.arabic: رَبِّ انصُرْنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
items.transliteration: Rabbi-nsurni bima kadhdhabooni

translation.en: My Lord, help me against the people who deny the truth.

virtues.en: Nuh made this du’a after centuries of patient da’wah. It teaches us to seek Allah’s help when facing rejection and to never despair of His support.

title.en: Du’a of Nuh — For His Son

items.arabic: رَبِّ إِنَّ ابْنِي مِنْ أَهْلِي وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ الْحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحْكَمُ الْحَاكِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbi inna ibni min ahli wa-inna wa’daka al-haqq wa-anta ahkam al-hakimeen

translation.en: My Lord, indeed my son is of my family, and indeed Your promise is true, and You are the most just of judges.

virtues.en: Nuh appealed to Allah for his disbelieving son during the flood. Allah corrected him, teaching that a disbeliever is not truly of one’s family in matters of faith.

title.en: Du’a of Iblis — A Warning (Contrast)

items.arabic: رَبِّ بِمَا أَغْوَيتَنِي لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbi bima aghwaytani la-uzayyinanna lahum fil-ardi wa-la-ughwiyanahum ajma’een

translation.en: My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make disobedience attractive to them on earth, and I will mislead them all.

virtues.en: Iblis’s request after his arrogance led to his expulsion. Included as a contrast — it shows how a du’a rooted in pride and rebellion is the opposite of the prophets’ humble supplications.

title.en: Dua for Makkah

items.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هَٰذَا بَلَدًا آمِنًا وَارْزُقْ أَهْلَهُ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ مَنْ آمَنَ مِنْهُم بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ
items.transliteration: Rabbij'al hadha baladan aminan warzuq ahlahu minath-thamarati man amana minhum billahi wal-yawmil-akhir.

translation.en: My Lord, make this a secure city and provide its people with fruits — whoever of them believes in Allah and the Last Day.
translation.ar: رب اجعل هذا بلداً آمناً وارزق أهله من الثمرات...

virtues.en: Dua of Ibrahim (AS) for Makkah.

title.en: Dua for Righteous Offspring

items.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbi hab li minas-salihin.

translation.en: My Lord, grant me from among the righteous.
translation.ar: رب هب لي من الصالحين

virtues.en: Allah responded by giving him Ismail (AS).

title.en: Dua for Acceptance of Deeds

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.transliteration: Rabbana taqabbal minna, innaka antas-Sami'ul-'Alim.

translation.en: Our Lord, accept it from us. Indeed, You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
translation.ar: ربنا تقبل منا إنك أنت السميع العليم

virtues.en: Dua of Ibrahim and Ismail when building the Ka'bah.
virtues.ar: دعاء إبراهيم وإسماعيل عند بناء الكعبة.

title.en: Dua for Family & Prayer

items.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
items.transliteration: Rabbij'alni muqimas-salati wa min dhurriyyati, Rabbana wa taqabbal du'a'.

translation.en: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
translation.ar: رب اجعلني مقيم الصلاة ومن ذريتي...

virtues.en: Dua for establishing prayer in the family.

title.en: Dua for Protection from Shirk

items.arabic: رَبِّ اجْنُبْنِي وَبَنِيَّ أَن نَّعْبُدَ الْأَصْنَامَ
items.transliteration: Rabbijnubni wa baniyya an na'budal-asnam.

translation.en: My Lord, keep me and my children away from worshipping idols.
translation.ar: رب اجنبني وبني أن نعبد الأصنام

virtues.en: Dua of Ibrahim (AS) for protection from shirk.

title.en: Dua in the Fire

items.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ ۖ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
items.transliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Azim.

translation.en: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no deity except Him. Upon Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the Magnificent Throne.
translation.ar: حسبي الله لا إله إلا هو عليه توكلت وهو رب العرش العظيم

reference.notes: This dua was said by Ibrahim (AS) when he was thrown into the fire, according to some narrations.

virtues.en: Allah suffices him who says this against what concerns him.
virtues.ar: من قالها كفاه الله ما أهمه.

title.en: Du’a of Ibrahim — Submission for Himself and Descendants

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ
items.transliteration: Rabbana-waj’alna muslimayni laka wa-min dhurriyyatina ummatan muslimatan laka

translation.en: Our Lord, make us both [fully] submitted to You and from our descendants a submitting community.

virtues.en: After building the Ka’bah, Ibrahim asked Allah to make him and his offspring submit to Him alone. This du’a encompasses every Muslim who came after.

title.en: Du’a of Ibrahim — Security of Makkah

items.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هَٰذَا الْبَلَدَ آمِنًا
items.transliteration: Rabbi-j’al hadha al-balada aminan

translation.en: My Lord, make this city [Makkah] secure.

virtues.en: Ibrahim prayed for the security of Makkah after settling his family there. Allah answered his du’a, making Makkah a sanctuary of peace to this day.

title.en: Du’a of Ibrahim — Forgiveness on the Day of Judgment

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
items.transliteration: Rabbana-ghfir li wa-liwalidayya wa-lil-mu’mineena yawma yaqum al-hisab

translation.en: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.

virtues.en: Ibrahim’s du’a encompasses not only himself and his parents but all believers. It reminds us to include the entire Ummah in our supplications.

title.en: Du’a of Ibrahim — Gratitude for Children in Old Age

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي وَهَبَ لِي عَلَى الْكِبَرِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِسْحَاقَ
items.transliteration: Al-hamdu lillahi alladhi wahaba li ’ala al-kibri Isma’ila wa-Ishaq

translation.en: All praise is due to Allah, who has granted me in old age Ishmael and Isaac.

virtues.en: Ibrahim expressed profound gratitude when Allah blessed him with two prophet-sons despite his and his wife’s advanced age. A model of shukr (gratitude) for blessings.

title.en: Dua for Chest Expansion

items.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي، وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي، وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي، يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
items.transliteration: Qala Rabbi-shrah li sadri, wa yassir li amri, wah-lul 'uqdatam min lisani, yafqahu qawli.

translation.en: He said: My Lord, expand for me my breast, ease for me my task, and untie the knot from my tongue, that they may understand my speech.
translation.ar: قال رب اشرح لي صدري ويسر لي أمري...

virtues.en: Excellent dua for students, speakers, and clarity.

title.en: Dua for Strength

items.arabic: وَاجْعَل لِّي وَزِيرًا مِّنْ أَهْلِي، هَارُونَ أَخِي، اشْدُدْ بِهِ أَزْرِي، وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِي أَمْرِي
items.transliteration: Waj'al li waziran min ahli, Haruna akhi, ishkud bihi azri, wa ashrikhu fi amri.

translation.en: And appoint for me a helper from my family — Harun, my brother. Strengthen my back through him, and let him share my task.
translation.ar: واجعل لي وزيراً من أهلي هارون أخي...

virtues.en: Dua for a supportive partner in good deeds.

title.en: Dua of Gratitude

items.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَا أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ فَلَنْ أَكُونَ ظَهِيرًا لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Qala Rabbi bima an'amta 'alayya falan akuna zahiral-lilmujrimin.

translation.en: He said: My Lord, for the favor You bestowed upon me, I will never be an assistant to the criminals.
translation.ar: قال رب بما أنعمت عليّ فلن أكون ظهيراً للمجرمين

virtues.en: Gratitude expressed through action — refusing to aid wrongdoing.

title.en: Dua for Provision

items.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
items.transliteration: Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqir.

translation.en: My Lord, I am in need of whatever good You send down to me.
translation.ar: رب إني لما أنزلت إليّ من خير فقير

virtues.en: Said by Musa (AS) when he arrived in Madyan. Allah responded by giving him a wife and a job.

title.en: Du’a of Musa — Expansion of the Chest

items.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
items.transliteration: Rabbi-shrah li sadri wa-yassir li amri

translation.en: My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance] and ease for me my task.

virtues.en: Musa made this du’a before confronting Pharaoh, the most powerful tyrant of his time. The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم recommended it before any difficult task or overwhelming situation.

title.en: Du’a of Musa — Increase in Knowledge

items.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
items.transliteration: Rabbi zidni ’ilman

translation.en: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

virtues.en: Despite being a prophet and having spoken directly to Allah, Musa still asked for more knowledge. This is the Quranic du’a for students and seekers of knowledge.

title.en: Du’a of Musa — Against Pharaoh’s Tyranny

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ آتَيتَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَأَهُ زِينَةً وَأَمْوالًا
items.transliteration: Rabbana innaka atayta Fir’awna wa-mala’ahu zeenatan wa-amwalan

translation.en: Our Lord, indeed You have granted Pharaoh and his establishment splendor and wealth.

virtues.en: Musa and Harun made this du’a together, acknowledging Allah’s power over tyrants and asking Him to destroy their corruption. A du’a against oppression.

title.en: Du’a of Musa — Repentance and Declaration of Faith

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
items.transliteration: Subhanaka tubtu ilayka wa-ana awwalu al-mu’mineen

translation.en: Exalted are You, I have repented to You, and I am the first of the believers.

virtues.en: After witnessing Allah’s manifestation at Mount Sinai, Musa fell unconscious then awoke declaring his faith and repentance. It shows the overwhelming awe of Allah’s presence.

title.en: Dua in the Belly of the Whale

items.arabic: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.

translation.en: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك إني كنت من الظالمين

virtues.en: No Muslim ever supplicates with it except that Allah responds.
virtues.ar: ما دعا بها مسلم في شيء قط إلا استجاب الله له.

title.en: Dua for a Righteous Child

items.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
items.transliteration: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibatan, innaka sami'ud-du'a'.

translation.en: My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.
translation.ar: رب هب لي من لدنك ذرية طيبة إنك سميع الدعاء

virtues.en: Allah responded by giving him Yahya (AS).

title.en: Dua for an Heir

items.arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbi la tatharni farda wa anta khayrul-warithin.

translation.en: My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no offspring], while You are the best of inheritors.
translation.ar: رب لا تذرني فرداً وأنت خير الوارثين

virtues.en: Dua of Zakariya (AS) when he was old.

title.en: Dua in Sickness & Hardship

items.arabic: وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Wa Ayyuba idh nada Rabbahu anni massaniyad-durru wa anta arhamur-rahimin.

translation.en: And [mention] Ayyub, when he called to his Lord: Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
translation.ar: وأيوب إذ نادى ربه أني مسني الضر وأنت أرحم الراحمين

virtues.en: The dua of patience in extreme hardship. Allah responded and cured him.

title.en: Du’a of Ayyub — In Affliction

items.arabic: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Anni massaniyad-durru wa-anta arhamur-rahimeen

translation.en: Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.

virtues.en: Ayyub suffered illness, loss of wealth, and death of his children for years, yet remained patient. When he finally made this brief du’a, Allah answered it immediately and restored everything doubled.

title.en: Dua for Gratitude

items.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'mataka allati an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala walidayya wa an a'mala salihan tardahu wa adkhilni bi-rahmatika fi 'ibadikas-salihin.

translation.en: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will be pleased and make me righteous with regard to my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims.
translation.ar: رب أوزعني أن أشكر نعمتك...

virtues.en: Dua of Sulayman (AS) when he heard the ant's speech.
virtues.ar: دعاء سليمان عند سماع قول النملة.

title.en: Du’a of Sulayman — Gratitude for Blessings

items.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ
items.transliteration: Rabbi awzi’ni an ashkura ni’mataka allati an’amta ’alayya wa-’ala walidayya

translation.en: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents.

virtues.en: Sulayman was given a kingdom unmatched by any before or after him — control over jinn, wind, and animals. Yet his first request was for the ability to be grateful. A profound lesson in humility.

description.en: Quranic supplications taught for all believers

title.en: Dua for Good in Both Worlds

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar.

translation.en: Our Lord, give us in this world good and in the Hereafter good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
translation.ar: ربنا آتنا في الدنيا حسنة وفي الآخرة حسنة وقنا عذاب النار

virtues.en: The most comprehensive dua in the Quran.

title.en: Dua for Steadfastness

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
items.transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana wa hab lana min ladunka rahmatan, innaka antal-Wahhab.

translation.en: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.
translation.ar: ربنا لا تزغ قلوبنا بعد إذ هديتنا...

virtues.en: Dua for steadfastness in faith.

title.en: Dua for Forgiveness for All Believers

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا ۚ رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
items.transliteration: Rabbana-ghfir lana wa li-ikhwaninal-ladhina sabaquna bil-imani wa la taj'al fi qulubina ghillan lilladhina amanu, Rabbana innaka ra'ufur-rahim.

translation.en: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts any resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful.
translation.ar: ربنا اغفر لنا ولإخواننا الذين سبقونا بالإيمان...

virtues.en: Purifies the heart from rancor.

title.en: Dua for Patience & Victory

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbana afrigh 'alayna sabran wa thabbit aqdamana wansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafirin.

translation.en: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.
translation.ar: ربنا أفرغ علينا صبراً وثبت أقدامنا...

virtues.en: Dua of Talut's army before battle.

title.en: Dua for Protection from Hellfire

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
items.transliteration: Rabbana-srif 'anna 'adhaba jahannam, inna 'adhabaha kana gharama.

translation.en: Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering.
translation.ar: ربنا اصرف عنا عذاب جهنم...

virtues.en: Dua of the servants of the Most Merciful.

title.en: Dua for Family Comfort

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
items.transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil-muttaqina imama.

translation.en: Our Lord, grant us from among our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader for the righteous.
translation.ar: ربنا هب لنا من أزواجنا وذرياتنا قرة أعين...

virtues.en: Dua for righteous family.

title.en: Dua for Acceptance

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.transliteration: Rabbana taqabbal minna, innaka antas-Sami'ul-'Alim.

translation.en: Our Lord, accept it from us. Indeed You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
translation.ar: ربنا تقبل منا إنك أنت السميع العليم

virtues.en: Dua of Ibrahim and Ismail when building the Ka'bah.

title.en: Dua for Parents

items.arabic: رَّبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
items.transliteration: Rabbirhamhuma kama rabbayani saghira.

translation.en: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small.
translation.ar: رب ارحمهما كما ربياني صغيراً

virtues.en: Quranic command to supplicate for parents.

title.en: Dua for Knowledge

items.arabic: رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
items.transliteration: Rabbi zidni ilma.

translation.en: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
translation.ar: رب زدني علماً

virtues.en: The only dua the Prophet ﷺ was commanded to make in the Quran.
virtues.ar: الدعاء الوحيد الذي أمر الله به نبيه.

title.en: Dua for Guidance (Al-Fatihah)

items.arabic: اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ، صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
items.transliteration: Ihdinas-siratal-mustaqim, siratal-ladhina an'amta 'alayhim ghayril-maghdubi 'alayhim wa lad-dallin.

translation.en: Guide us to the straight path — the path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked anger or of those who are astray.
translation.ar: اهدنا الصراط المستقيم...

virtues.en: The most recited dua — in every unit of prayer.

title.en: Dua for Ease

items.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
items.transliteration: Rabbi-shrah li sadri wa yassir li amri.

translation.en: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task.
translation.ar: رب اشرح لي صدري ويسر لي أمري

virtues.en: Dua of Musa (AS) before any difficult task.

title.en: Dua for Protection from Misguidance

items.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ ۖ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِي وَتَرْحَمْنِي أَكُن مِّنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbi inni a'udhu bika an as'alaka ma laysa li bihi 'ilmun, wa illa taghfir li wa tarhamni akun minal-khasirin.

translation.en: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have mercy upon me, I will be of the losers.
translation.ar: رب إني أعوذ بك أن أسألك ما ليس لي به علم...

virtues.en: Dua of Nuh (AS).

title.en: Du’a of the Believers — Steadfastness After Guidance

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً
items.transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba’da idh hadaytana wa-hab lana min ladunka rahmah

translation.en: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us from Yourself mercy.

virtues.en: The believers’ du’a after hearing about the People of the Book who changed their scriptures. A vital du’a to protect one’s faith and prevent spiritual drift.

title.en: Du’a of the Believers — Forgiveness for Sins and Excesses

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا
items.transliteration: Rabbana-ghfir lana dhunoobana wa-israfana fi amrina

translation.en: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and our extravagance in our affairs.

virtues.en: This du’a was made by the believers during the Battle of Uhud after they disobeyed the Prophet’s orders. It acknowledges both sins and excesses, seeking comprehensive forgiveness.

title.en: Du’a of the Believers — Mercy and Right Guidance

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan wa-hayyi’ lana min amrina rashadan

translation.en: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.

virtues.en: The du’a of the Youth of the Cave (Ashab al-Kahf) when they fled their people to preserve their faith. It combines asking for Allah’s mercy with seeking His guidance in all affairs.

title.en: Du’a of the Believers — Gratitude for Blessings

items.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ
items.transliteration: Rabbi awzi’ni an ashkura ni’mataka allati an’amta ’alayya

translation.en: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me.

virtues.en: A du’a for gratitude that any believer can make. Asking Allah for the ability to be thankful is itself an act of gratitude. This prayer ensures we recognize and appreciate Allah’s countless blessings.

title.en: Du’a of the Believers — Rescue from Oppressors

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbana la taj’alna fitnatan lil-qawmidh-zalimeen wa-najjina bi-rahmatika minal-qawmil-kafireen

translation.en: Our Lord, make us not [a trial] for the wrongdoing people and save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people.

virtues.en: The du’a of Musa’s people when they faced Pharaoh’s persecution. It asks Allah to protect believers from being a means of trial and to rescue them from oppressors.

title.en: Du’a of the Believers — Sufficiency of Allah

items.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
items.transliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa ’alayhi tawakkaltu wa-huwa Rabbul-’Arshil-’Azeem

translation.en: Sufficient for me is Allah; there is no deity except Him. Upon Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.

virtues.en: Ibrahim recited these words when he was thrown into the fire, and the fire became cool and safe. The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم said: “Whoever says it seven times in the morning and evening, Allah will suffice him for whatever concerns him.” (Abu Dawud 5075)

title.en: Du’a of the Believers — Forgiveness for All Believers

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَإِخْوَانَنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana-ghfir lana wa-ikhwanana alladheena sabaquna bil-iman

translation.en: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith.

virtues.en: The believers’ du’a from Surah al-Hashr. It teaches us to include all Muslims — past, present, and future — in our prayers for forgiveness. A beautiful expression of Ummah unity.

title.en: Du’a of Dawud — For an Unmatched Kingdom

items.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَهِبْ لِي مُلْكًا لَّا يَنبَغِي لِأَحَدٍ مِّن بَعْدِي
items.transliteration: Rabbi-ghfir li wa-hib li mulkan la yanbaghi li-ahadin min ba’di

translation.en: My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me.

virtues.en: Dawud combined seeking forgiveness with asking for a unique blessing. Allah answered both parts of his du’a — forgiving him and granting him an unparalleled kingdom.

title.en: Du’a of Isa — The Heavenly Table

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَائِدَةً مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma Rabbana anzil ’alayna ma’idatan minas-sama’i

translation.en: O Allah, our Lord, send down to us a table [spread with food] from the heaven.

virtues.en: Isa made this du’a when the Hawariyyun (disciples) requested a miraculous feast as a sign. It shows that even prophets turn to Allah for provision and signs.

title.en: Du’a of Isa — Surrendering Judgment to Allah

items.arabic: إِن تُعَذِّبْهُمْ فإِنَّهُمْ عِبَادُكَ وَإِن تَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ فإِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
items.transliteration: In tu’adhdhibhum fa-innahum ’ibaduka, wa-in taghfir lahum fa-innaka Antal-’Azeezul-Hakeem

translation.en: If You should punish them — indeed they are Your servants; but if You forgive them — indeed it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

virtues.en: Isa will say this on the Day of Judgment when Allah asks him about those who took him and his mother as deities. It is the ultimate expression of entrusting all matters to Allah’s wisdom.

title.en: Du’a of Muhammad — Refuge from Cowardice and Miserliness

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ البُخْلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أُرَدَّ إِلَىٰ أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a’udhu bika min al-jubni, wa-a’udhu bika min al-bukhli, wa-a’udhu bika min an uradda ila ardhali al-’umur

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from cowardice, and I seek refuge in You from miserliness, and I seek refuge in You from being returned to the worst of old age.

virtues.en: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم regularly sought refuge from these three spiritual ailments. A comprehensive du’a for courage, generosity, and vitality.

title.en: Du’a of Muhammad — Guidance, Taqwa, Chastity, and Sufficiency

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَىٰ وَالتُّقَىٰ وَالْعَفَافَ وَالغَنَىٰ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as-alukal-huda wat-taqwa wal-’afafa wal-ghina

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and self-sufficiency.

virtues.en: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم would supplicate with these four comprehensive requests. Together they encompass the complete well-being of a believer — spiritual, moral, and material.

title.en: Du’a of Muhammad — Goodness in Both Worlds

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa-fil-akhirati hasanatan wa-qina ’adhaban-nar

translation.en: Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

virtues.en: One of the most comprehensive and frequently recited duas of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم. Anas ibn Malik said it was the most frequent du’a of the Prophet. It covers all worldly and spiritual needs.

title.en: Du’a of Muhammad — Rectification of Religion and Worldly Life

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِي الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي
items.transliteration: Allahumma aslih li deeni alladhi huwa ’ismatu amri, wa-aslih li dunyaya allati fiha ma’ashi

translation.en: O Allah, rectify for me my religion which is the safeguard of my affairs, and rectify for me my worldly life wherein is my livelihood.

virtues.en: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم prioritized the rectification of religion above all else, recognizing it as the foundation of all other success. A beautifully balanced du’a.

title.en: Du’a of Muhammad — Ease in Difficulties

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلتَهُ سَهْلًا وَأَنتَ تَجْعَلُ الحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئتَ سَهْلًا
items.transliteration: Allahumma la sahla illa ma ja’altahu sahalan, wa-anta taj’al al-hazna idha shi’ta sahalan

translation.en: O Allah, there is no ease except what You make easy, and You make the difficult easy if You will.

virtues.en: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم taught this du’a to acknowledge that all ease comes from Allah alone. A powerful reminder when facing any difficulty.
